items.q: I contacted Wesley Helvey (PHONETIC) and Zack White.

ctx.x: So we went in there, and we stayed I guess about two months. Now, coming on back home, well I wasn't too particular coming back home. So they get to talking about -- they were out of Richmond. Said, "If we go back to Richmond you'll love it. We've got it locked up around there. We have the -- gigs all the time, you know." And they'd be talking and I'd be listening, you know, and so -- but I'm a little smarter now, see, because Horace said, "Well, don't worry about it. When we leave here we're going into…
